title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Section_9
doc_notes: This document is an FBI case file regarding reports of unidentified flying objects and the Bureau's policy of referring such matters to the Air Force, containing several specific encounter reports. / This document is a collection of FBI case files and memoranda regarding UFO sightings, public inquiries, and internal policy, confirming the FBI's stance of referring such matters to the Air Force.

encounters.summary: Two individuals claimed to have seen a flying disc in the shape of a man's hat hovering over the Matahambre Mines area for several minutes before it disappeared at high speed toward the sea.
encounters.location_name: Matahambre Mines, Pinar del Rio Province

encounters.summary: A woman reported that she and her three daughters observed a silent, motionless, dome-shaped object hovering near their farm, which she believed was taking pictures; she later found strange newspapers and magazines on her property.
encounters.communication_content: She claimed the entities left newspapers and magazines and provided a key to a strange print in a newspaper.
encounters.quote: I realized at once there were human beings guiding it.

encounters.summary: A photographer reported observing a flat, oval-shaped object with a fluorescent glow and a vapor trail in a photograph he took of the moon through a telescope.
encounters.entity_appearance: flat on bottom, oval shaped, fluorescent glow
encounters.quote: it is flat on the bottom, is oval shaped, and appears to have a fluorescent glow

encounters.summary: George W. Van Tassel claimed to have been visited by people from outer space and to have taken up a crusade to bring facts about them to the American people.
encounters.communication_content: Space people communicate by knowing thoughts; many are mute but some are trained to speak earth languages.
encounters.entity_behavior: Concerned with atom bombs; have the power to know thoughts; use crystal batteries to bend light and appear invisible.
encounters.quote: I have also been visited by the people from outer space

encounters.summary: Joseph Perry claimed a photograph of the moon contained a flying object, which the Air Force attributed to a development error.
encounters.quote: what appeared to be a flying object somewhere in the vicinity of the moon

encounters.summary: Lonnie Zamora, a police officer, reported seeing a landed oval-shaped object with two occupants in white coveralls, which then took off with a roar and flames.
encounters.entity_appearance: Two persons in apparent white coveralls.
encounters.quote: oval shaped, similar to football, possibly twenty feet long

encounters.summary: Orlando Gallegos reported seeing a butane-tank-shaped object on the ground surrounded by a blue-white flame.
encounters.entity_appearance: Object shaped like a butane tank or telephone pole.
encounters.entity_behavior: Surrounded by blue-white flame from portholes.
encounters.quote: something shaped like a butane tank, possibly twelve to fourteen feet high
